prompt: Use case: game UI card template. ONE perfectly flat front-facing rectangular collectible card background for Babylon Chronicle ancient Mesopotamian fantasy RPG. Portrait 2:3 ratio, 1024x1536. Extremely refined hand-painted material textures, restrained illumination, old manuscript and glazed Babylonian relief details. This is an EMPTY card template, NO characters, NO creatures, NO text, NO letters, NO numbers, NO legible inscriptions, NO modern UI. Edge-to-edge card with thin antique-metal border at 3% inset. Clear blank header band y=8-14%; central illustration area x=12-88%, y=18-75% almost completely empty subdued background so a full-body character will be overlaid later; blank bottom plaque y=80-92% with enough uninterrupted space for a Chinese name. Decoration concentrated at outer edges, no elements crossing the blank central illustration area. Straight edges, no perspective, no table, no hands, no outside background, do not depict multiple cards.  GOLD STAR COLLECTION: antique-gold edging, lapis-blue fine inlay, very restrained rosette and barley reliefs at four corners, parchment-ivory center fading very gently to warm muted tan at bottom. Golden eight-point Mesopotamian star small at very top center ABOVE header band. Elegant sacred celestial artifact, NOT modern tarot occult artwork, no zodiac symbols in center. Bottom name plaque is matte dark navy with slender gold border. Upper blank header is subtly light parchment. Border highly polished artisan bronze-gold, tactile but tasteful, no loud lens flare.
